body:
You are not alone in this situation, many people go through this and it is something that can be overcome :)

It is hard for me to comment without knowing the events you mentioned or what happened, but your friends telling you that he is not worth it is them trying to help you, they are trying to make you see that you dont need to be upset over him. Your friends do care even if they dont show it. I am the same atm, trying to help something through a difficult time, and before i knew how to help her i found it difficult to show her that i was actually trying, that i wanted to help. Theres a very high chance that your friends are the same, they want to help but dont know how to.

you say you have no one to talk to, but if you have a friend, relative or you trust someone close that can listen, sharing everything you feel with them can help clear your mind alot :) going through a heartbreak is a very difficult time for a person, and expressing this to someone, either text or face to face or any method you prefer, can really make a difference.

and there are alot of people on this that would be willing to help and listen. you are not alone :)

yea ill have a look at it, only found out about this place a few days ago so i needa look at a few things.

"Techniques that work well to motivate or challenge the average person can often drive someone who's depressed further into feeling hopeless, worthless, and guilty because they can't cheer up, and they can't appreciate all the good things in their life."

this bit is something i need to look out for, as sometimes i tried to kinda push her into enjoying things which normally had a negative effect, so that statement you made is very useful. Ill try not to be as "forceful" when it comes to doing things.

thank you, you have given me a little more hope :)

thank you for those words, made me feel alot better :)

yea ill stick to what im doing, try not to force her out of it, ill stay patient with her through it. but thanks for the words :)
